# 📺 Pluto TV Auto-Generated M3U Playlist & EPG

[![Auto Update Playlist & EPG](https://github.com/sulthanpamenan/pluto-playlist/actions/workflows/auto_update.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sulthanpamenan/pluto-playlist/actions/workflows/auto_update.yml)
[![GitHub Pages](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Pages-Active-success?logo=github)](https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/pluto-playlist/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live%20TV-Active-blue)](#-key-features)

An automated M3U playlist and XMLTV EPG provider for **Pluto TV** live streaming. Designed for seamless playback across all major IPTV players.

---

## 🔗 Live URLs

Import these links directly into your preferred IPTV player (TiviMate, OTT Navigator, VLC, Televizo, etc.):

| Content | URL | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Playlist (TXT)** *(Recommended)* | `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/pluto-playlist/playlist.txt` | Standard playlist format with official playback parameters |
| **Playlist (M3U)** | `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/pluto-playlist/playlist.m3u` | Direct `.m3u` extension format for player compatibility |
| **EPG (XMLTV)** | `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/pluto-playlist/epg.xml` | Electronic Program Guide containing complete show schedules |

---

## ✨ Key Features

- **Auto-Updated Stream:** Automated background updates to ensure active session tokens and reliable playback.
- **Full EPG Metadata:** Detailed show descriptions, episode info, channel logos, and category tags.
- **Universal Compatibility:** Fully standardized format for all M3U & XMLTV supported IPTV applications.
- **No VPN Required:** Direct stream access supported across local and international networks.

---

## 🚀 Quick Setup Guide

1. Open your IPTV application (e.g., **TiviMate** or **OTT Navigator**).
2. Add a new **M3U Playlist** and enter the playlist URL:
   `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/pluto-playlist/playlist.m3u`
3. Add the **EPG Source** and enter the TV Guide URL:
   `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/pluto-playlist/epg.xml`
4. Reload your playlist and TV Guide to start watching.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is created for educational and personal automation purposes only. No video streams are hosted on this repository. All links redirect directly to Pluto TV's official public servers. Pluto TV is a registered trademark of Paramount Global.
